description: Find the closest equivalent wig colors in a target brand for a known color in another brand, using MyHairMail's proprietary cross-brand color mapping. Returns up to 3 closest matches with optional in-stock example styles. One source color and one target brand per call. Never request all brands. Terms: https://mcp.myhairmailtools.com/terms

source_brand.description: Brand of the known color, e.g. 'Jon Renau'

source_color.description: Color code or name, e.g. '12FS8' or 'Shaded Praline'

target_brand.description: Single brand to match into, e.g. 'Belle Tress'. Wildcards and 'all brands' are not supported.

name: color_crossmatch
